entries.summary: AgentHub completes a full-stack security and reliability hardening pass and aligns the active product scope around Claude Code and Codex, making the self-hosted remote workspace safer and more dependable for long-running work.
changes: Keep the Web root secret in memory only; refreshing or closing the page now requires signing in again instead of persisting the root secret in browser storage
Harden server pairing, token lifetime and revocation, replay protection, request limits, concurrency backpressure, tenant boundaries, and sensitive-log redaction
Improve daemon, runner, and systemd recovery so active turns, thinking state, and archives finish correctly during updates, stops, and abnormal exits
Optimize long sessions, file previews, cancellable prefetching, bounded caches, and lazy-loaded resources to reduce memory and startup cost on large projects
Add local sharing for explicitly selected content and revocable, time-limited, scope-limited end-to-end encrypted external shares
Improve accessibility and interaction consistency across buttons, tabs, selection rows, focus states, touch targets, page states, and localized copy
Limit the active runtime to Claude Code and Codex; legacy Provider messages remain read-only and no longer expose creation, authentication, or configuration entry points
Align the release with CLI 1.0.4, the Android production arm64 package, and the server key-migration guidance

entries.summary: AgentHub enters a new visual identity phase while completing official session synchronization, creating a more consistent experience across mobile, Web, and desktop.
changes: Refresh the AgentHub visual identity with richer glass, ceramic, highlight, and soft-texture treatments in both dark and light themes
Unify the chat composer, tool-call cards, settings, file details, and code panels under the new visual language
Add official Claude and Codex session synchronization and recovery so the App can take over and continue official threads more reliably
Replace pull-to-sync on the session screen with a top-right manual sync action to avoid accidental refreshes while scrolling desktop session children
Refine the mobile 1.0 experience across navigation, session titles, chat layout, settings, and common actions
Refresh the AgentHub 1.0 documentation, brand boundaries, and project status for clearer release and collaboration workflows
Fix stability issues found during the 1.0 audit and ensure the AgentHub CLI executable keeps the correct permissions

entries.summary: The Android production package, daemon update workflow, and Web verification path now form a complete loop, substantially improving pre-release engineering reliability.
changes: Standardize Android production builds under the artifacts directory and automatically refresh the latest APK
Improve Android splash, preview, and production build scripts to reduce manual delivery errors
Harden daemon updates so systemd-managed processes are not terminated incorrectly and sessions do not remain stuck in a thinking state
Ensure agent runners finish an active turn on SIGTERM, archive, and abnormal exit
Establish an authenticated Web verification flow that avoids repeated QR scanning and reliably reuses a signed-in development environment
Improve continuous branch rendering in Git Graph for more coherent lines in complex histories
Fix weak hierarchy, harsh edges, and insufficient contrast across multiple light-theme surfaces

entries.summary: File transfer, remote file workflows, and session synchronization receive focused improvements, making real project work on mobile more reliable.
changes: Add device file-transfer management for viewing and managing remote transfer tasks
Improve remote downloads, retries, status feedback, and opening files on mobile
Strengthen recovery after transfer failures so unstable networks are easier to resume from
Fix Markdown code-block previews, empty code blocks, and file-preview edge cases
Synchronize session thinking state to reduce disagreement between the App and the running Agent
Fix the context-usage ring and usage queries so statistics reflect update times accurately
Improve daemon restart and session convergence to reduce state drift after restarts

entries.summary: Android interaction, theming, and client Agent support receive a full cleanup in preparation for release.
changes: Streamline Android session entry, recovery, and management flows
Make output handling more consistent across Claude, Codex, and other client Agents
Improve Android dark and light themes, the composer, tools, and common status displays
Add App interaction previews and refine Codex output handling for better coverage of real chat scenarios
Rework the Android preview-package pipeline for clearer artifacts and configuration
Stop tracking APK and other build outputs to reduce repository size and commit noise
Improve public deployment and stabilization verification for cross-device testing

entries.summary: Settings, device management, synchronization protocols, and scaling gain foundational capabilities that make the App better suited to everyday long-running use.
changes: Add independent scaling for the session list, chat screen, and file preview to fit different displays and reading preferences
Improve device grouping, group state, and navigation to machine details
Introduce the v4 synchronization protocol foundation and harden server protocols and sensitive endpoints
Expand v4 synchronization route coverage, recent features, and edge-case tests
Fix client routing and authentication state for more reliable switching between Web and App pages
Add 80 curated Twemoji PNG assets for project icons and visual identity
Add a standalone Web test script for faster App page and interaction verification

entries.summary: This release introduces project-grouped sessions, customizable project icons, and several stability and reliability improvements.
changes: Group sessions by project directory and support viewing archived sessions within each project
Allow every project to use a custom name and one of 80 curated Emoji icons, editable from the project header
Replace the old pixel, gradient, and brutalist Avatar systems with project Emoji icons
Remove Avatar style and AI Provider icon choices from appearance settings
Fix thinking-animation flicker during message synchronization
Forward complete tool-call results to clients, including output and error state
Support completed, failed, cancelled, and timed-out tool states from more AI Agent backends

entries.summary: The file browser gains folder navigation and breadcrumbs, larger icons, and a dark-mode-aware preview panel.
changes: Add folder navigation to the file picker for browsing directories level by level
Add a breadcrumb path bar for quick navigation to any parent directory
Increase file icons throughout the directory tree and file list for easier recognition
Use theme colors in the preview panel so it renders correctly in dark mode
Add cache cleanup and automatic artifact naming to the Android build script

entries.summary: The chat composer now supports image attachments and slash commands while a more focused interface removes social features.
changes: Send image attachments to AI directly from the photo library
Add a unified attachment menu for project files and local images
Add a slash-command menu for inserting common commands quickly
Add folder creation to the file browser
Refine the directory drawer and file-preview layout with a wider desktop preview area
Remove friends, inbox, and activity features, leaving focused Sessions and Settings tabs
Remove the voice button from the chat composer

entries.summary: A new visual folder browser lets users choose remote directories when creating a session without typing paths manually.
changes: Add a visual folder browser to the new-session screen
Add a Browse action to machine details for fast folder selection
Support switching between browsing and manual path entry
Support hidden folders plus quick access to recent paths and the home directory

entries.summary: Voice-call reliability, content rendering, and a new diff viewer improve the day-to-day experience.
changes: Fix voice calls ending during a second session so repeated calls remain reliable
Allow horizontal scrolling for tables and code blocks instead of overflowing the screen
Add a syntax-highlighted diff viewer with unified and split layouts on desktop and Web
Persist model and effort-level selections on mobile
Preserve accept and reject permission prompts
Prevent settings from resetting unpredictably during synchronization
Add a scroll-to-bottom action to chat
Allow unused machines to be deleted from Settings

entries.summary: This update adds current Gemini models, smarter voice guidance, and more reliable plan approval and Codex turns in AgentHub CLI sessions.
changes: Update AgentHub CLI by running `npm i -g /agenthub`
Add current Gemini models to the model picker
Improve first-use voice guidance and make free-tier upgrade guidance clearer
Fix AgentHub CLI plan approval so accept and reject actions appear reliably in plan mode
Fix background task updates and occasional Codex turns that hang or fail to complete

entries.summary: Our largest update since launch introduces a new session-creation experience, Git worktree management, and broader Agent support.
changes: Redesign session creation with machine and worktree selection, draft persistence, and visibility for offline machines
Add Git worktree listing, creation, and selection, with automatic cleanup when a session is deleted
Switch automatically into plan mode when the Agent enters plan mode
Add OpenClaw alongside Claude Code and Codex as an optional AI Agent
Add session quick actions for faster interaction with active sessions
Resume sessions from where they stopped
Delete sessions directly from session information
Rename the bypass permission mode to yolo and refresh its styling
Improve Markdown rendering and message formatting
Fix edge cases and improve message synchronization reliability
Refine UI details including send-loading animation, hidden internal tool calls, and spacing

entries.summary: This update broadens AI Agent support, refines voice interactions, and improves Markdown rendering for a better chat experience.
changes: Begin adding Gemini through ACP and prepare the same approach for Codex stability improvements
Remove mobile Agent model configuration because model changes outpaced the App; configure it through the CLI and AgentHub will use the default
Require a subscription after three free ElevenLabs voice calls while preparing support for connecting a user-owned ElevenLabs Agent
Render real formatted Markdown tables in chat instead of ASCII pipe layouts, with further layout refinements still in progress

entries.summary: Codex integration and daemon mode transform remote development with instant AI assistance while preserving full control of the development environment.
changes: Add Codex support for advanced AI-assisted code completion and generation
Make daemon mode the default so remote sessions can start immediately without launching the CLI manually
Start sessions from a mobile device with one tap and connect to the development machine automatically
Add account connections for Anthropic and GPT

entries.summary: This update brings developer identity into AgentHub through seamless GitHub integration while maintaining our commitment to privacy and security.
changes: Add GitHub account connection through a secure OAuth flow
Synchronize profile data including GitHub avatar, name, and bio
Store tokens encrypted on the backend for additional protection
Enhance Settings with the connected personalized profile
Add one-tap GitHub disconnection with confirmation protection
Improve account management with clear connection-state indicators

entries.summary: This release focuses on seamless device connection, visual polish, and intelligent voice interactions.
changes: Add QR authentication for instant, secure cross-platform device pairing
Introduce a complete dark theme with automatic system-preference detection
Improve voice-assistant speed and latency
Show visual indicators for modified files directly in the session list
Add preferred-language selection for the voice assistant with support for more than 15 languages

entries.summary: Welcome to AgentHub, your secure and encrypted mobile companion for Claude Code. The first release establishes private, powerful AI interaction from anywhere.
changes: Implement end-to-end encrypted session management for complete privacy
Integrate an intelligent voice assistant for natural conversations
Add an experimental file manager with syntax highlighting and tree navigation
Build seamless real-time synchronization across devices
Support iOS, Android, and responsive Web interfaces
